purpose: Milestone 9.7 Sections 6/7/8: full preregistration of the M9.8 HydroCore-S vs HydroCore-M capacity comparison, frozen BEFORE any HydroCore-M development-performance number is observed.

arms.ARM_S: frozen HydroCore-S architecture (variant='small', 4,182,612 params) + frozen M9.6 ARM_B_M9_6 interleaved recipe -- reuse M9.6's own trained checkpoints where available (zero redundant retraining), matching the M9.1/M9.0b checkpoint-reuse convention: read m9-6-training-runs/ARM_B_M9_6-seed{seed}.json's export_path/export_sha256, verify SHA-256 on disk, load if present; if the checkpoint blob is physically absent, retrain from scratch using the exact frozen M9.6 ARM_B recipe/config/seed and record REGENERATED_NOT_ORIGINAL_M9_6_CHECKPOINT (vs REUSED_M9_6_CHECKPOINT) transparently, per M9.1 protocol Section 2's precedent.
arms.ARM_M: HydroCore-M (variant='small_v5_capacity_m', 13,919,572 params, m9-7-selected-m-architecture.json) + IDENTICAL recipe to ARM_S except capacity -- always trained fresh (no prior M checkpoint exists).

primary_endpoint.name: unseen-topology MATURE neural Top-1, macro-averaged equally across unseen topology families
primary_endpoint.definition: for each unseen family, mean neural source_node argmax top-1 accuracy at MATURE depths (12,25) over that family's development-representative incidents; macro-average (equal weight per family, NOT incident-weighted) across the 3 families -- IDENTICAL construction to M9.6's own primary metric (m9-6-summary.md 'Predictive generalization (unseen macro-family MATURE Top-1, ARM_B - ARM_A)'), applied here as ARM_M - ARM_S instead of ARM_B - ARM_A.
primary_endpoint.posterior_used: neural predictor's own source_node posterior only (softmax(source_node_logits)) -- never the classical or hybrid-fused posterior, matching M9.1 Section 11.1's standing convention.

statistical_procedure.method: paired bootstrap, family-stratified / matched-incident, consistent with the corrected source-representative M9.4-M9.6 methodology
statistical_procedure.resampling_unit: incidents (matching M8.7 Section 10 / M9.1 Section 14's own convention)
statistical_procedure.bootstrap_seed_provenance: Deterministic, unused, chronologically-next 8-digit v5 seed: verified absent from every existing .py/.json/.md artifact in this repository at M9.7 freeze time (grep -rn '\b20260819\b' returned zero hits before this document was written). Distinct from M9.6's own bootstrap seed (20260818) and the standing confirmation seed (20260815).
statistical_procedure.representative_seed_convention: seed 31874 remains the standing representative seed for any screening-stage/representative-seed reporting, matching M8.7/M9.0b/M9.1's established convention.

practical_effect_threshold.historical_precedent_search: Searched the master protocol (docs/evaluation/HYDROCORE_V5_EXPERIMENT_PROTOCOL.md Section 6, which cites 'Milestone 9.2's worked examples') and the original /workspace/experiments.txt Milestone 9.2 'Promotion philosophy' section. No exact numeric threshold is preregistered anywhere in this repository -- experiments.txt Milestone 9.2 gives only QUALITATIVE worked examples: a +10pp gain (4M 67% -> 16M 77%) is judged meaningful (select the larger model); a +1-2pp gain (4M 67% -> 16M 68%) is judged NOT meaningful (retain the 4M model). No repo artifact under reports/evaluation/hydrocore-v5/ names a specific pp threshold for this decision -- M9.2 and M9.3 as actually executed in this branch's history are unrelated diagnostic-only studies (reports/evaluation/hydrocore-v5/m9-2/m9-2-summary.md, m9-3-summary.md), not the capacity-scaling 'Milestone 9.2' the master protocol's Section 6 prose originally anticipated under the pre-renumbering experiments.txt plan.
practical_effect_threshold.adopted_rule_note: Since no repo-preregistered NUMERIC threshold exists to inherit, the quantitative floor proposed in this M9.7 task prompt (+0.02 absolute primary-metric gain with a 90% CI lower bound > 0) is adopted as the FROZEN M9.8 promotion rule. This value sits consistently with, and does not contradict, experiments.txt's own qualitative precedent: its own 'not meaningful' worked example is a +1pp gain, and this frozen floor (+2pp) sits just above that -- not below it -- so it does not lower the bar experiments.txt's own example already set as insufficient.

A_primary_effect.condition: M - S >= +0.02 absolute on the primary endpoint AND paired-bootstrap 90% CI lower bound > 0

B_family_consistency.condition: M improves at least 2 of the 3 unseen families AND no unseen family regresses by more than 0.03 absolute

C_seed_consistency.condition: no catastrophic seed reversal; all three seed deltas individually reported (never collapsed to a mean before being recorded)

D_known_family_retention.condition: relative to S: EARLY Top-1 regression <= 0.05 absolute; MATURE Top-1 regression <= 0.03 absolute; MRR regression <= 0.03

E_calibration.condition: alpha remains 0.1; required coverage >= 0.85 for every predeclared required seed/family bucket per the corrected M9.6 calibration policy; candidate-set-size guard passes

F_engineering.condition: no NaN/Inf/instability; no causal violation; no checkpoint/resume defect; no source-support regression

G_capacity_cost.condition: latency and memory reported (m9-7-latency-memory.json baseline + M9.8's own re-measurement if code changed materially); no post-hoc cost threshold invented -- none exists in the repository/master protocol to inherit, so none is imposed

predeclared_decisions.B: HYDROCORE_M_NO_MEANINGFUL_CAPACITY_GAIN -- A fails (no significant/practical primary-effect gain); retain HydroCore-S; do not authorize HydroCore-L.
predeclared_decisions.C: HYDROCORE_M_PREDICTIVE_GAIN_BUT_GUARDRAIL_FAILURE -- A passes but one or more of B-F fails; retain HydroCore-S; no L.
predeclared_decisions.D: HYDROCORE_M_INCONCLUSIVE -- ambiguous/borderline result not cleanly matching A/B/C (e.g. CI straddling the +0.02 floor); retain HydroCore-S unless a separately governed confirmation is justified; no automatic L.
predeclared_decisions.E: ENGINEERING_OR_COMPARABILITY_BLOCKER -- an engineering or compute-comparability problem prevents a fair M9.8 comparison from being run at all.

future_l_preconditions: M produces a meaningful validated gain over S (M9.8 Decision A)
M still demonstrates measurable unresolved capacity-related headroom
the remaining error is plausibly capacity-limited rather than data-limited, topology-limited, source-identifiability-limited, calibration-limited, or irreducible hydraulic ambiguity
a separate protocol is frozen before any L experiment begins
